meta.name: python-appservice-deploy
meta.description: Deploy Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. WHEN: "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", "FastAPI App Service", "deploy Python to App Service". DO NOT USE FOR: Container Apps, Functions, non-Python, Terraform/Bicep/IaC, full infra — use azure-prepare.

copy.tagline: 将Python应用部署到Azure App Service
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的Python应用需要部署到Azure App Service
copy.tagline_en: Deploy Python apps to Azure App Service
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to deploy Python apps to Azure App Service

howto.what: 将 Python 代码(Flask、Django、FastAPI 等)部署到 Azure App Service Linux。它会自动创建或复用资源组、服务套餐和 Web 应用,设置启动命令和构建开关,完成部署后给出 https 网址,不做运行检查。
howto.when: 当你提到“Flask App Service”、“Django App Service”等关键词,或要求把 Python 代码部署到 Azure App Service 时触发。

say.text: 把我的 Flask 应用部署到 Azure App Service
say.note: Claude 会创建资源并部署,给出网址。

say.text: 帮我用 azd 部署 Django 到 App Service
say.note: 会走 azd 部署路径。

say.text: 部署 FastAPI 到 App Service Linux,用 CLI
say.note: 会设置 uvicorn 启动命令并部署。

howto.what_en: Deploys Python (Flask/Django/FastAPI) code to Azure App Service Linux. Creates or reuses resource group, plan, and web app; sets startup and build flag; prints HTTPS URL after deploy; skips verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "Flask App Service", "Django App Service", or request deploying Python to App Service.

say_en.text: Deploy my Flask app to Azure App Service
say_en.note: It will create resources, deploy, and give the URL.

say_en.text: Deploy my Django app to App Service using azd
Deploy FastAPI to App Service Linux with CLI
say_en.note: Sets uvicorn startup command and deploys.
